narrative_playbooks.title: 早期预警：Reid Hoffman on Crypto and AI Identity

避免把单点热搜包装成全市场主线

narrative_playbooks.title: 轮动对照稿
narrative_playbooks.why_now: 把成熟主线和早期火种放在一起，更能体现市场结构变化。
actions: 把 Proposal for a Harambe Meme Coin 写成“已确认主线”
把 Reid Hoffman on Crypto and AI Identity 写成“早期火种”
